name: docker-image-ci
title: Docker image build, compose, and GHCR release workflow
description: Add Docker packaging to reproxy: multi-stage Dockerfile for the CGO-disabled static binary, docker-compose.yml for one-command local deployment, and a GitHub Actions workflow that fetches the repo's fresh snapshot at the latest released version and builds+publishes versioned images. Registry choice, tag taxonomy, multi-arch, caching, and security posture to be converged via dbs-chatroom round 6 before the PRD is frozen.
